CustomField.description: Live stock check of the Plant: CHECK: oversold / Out of stock / In stock. Excel: Daily Sell column H.
CustomField.formula: IF(Plant__r.Stock_Remaining__c < 0, "CHECK: oversold", IF(Plant__r.Stock_Remaining__c = 0, "Out of stock", "In stock"))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Current stock status of this plant (live value).
CustomField.label: Stock Check
